body.title: Final build and full sweep
body.summary: Run tsc and the planner and analyze test sweeps. The live docs-broad regression (INSRC_LIVE_TESTS=1, docs-broad-live.test.ts) needs the new code running in the daemon, so it is run after the push and daemon update, and its outcome is stated in the BUILD record as a reported live result, not a gate-run test. A failure after the count and the exact range were shown triggers the band revisit written in the LLD.
acceptanceChecks: tsc build passes and the planner and analyze tests pass, with unrelated pre-existing failures named separately
the live regression is recorded as a reported result with its outcome (final report reached, or the failing stage and invariant), or recorded as not yet run with the reason

tests.name: src/analyze/orchestrator/__tests__/docs-broad-live.test.ts: the broad docs request runs to a final report
